core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix admin utility with consumer app fluidity
Emotion First: The header should feel like a 'Command Center' - dark, sleek, precise
Content is King: Filters are the primary navigation
Negative Space: Even in a dense header, use padding to prevent clutter
Contrast: High contrast for active states against the dark navy background

header_container.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full flex flex-col gap-3 p-4 bg-[#1e293b] shadow-lg border-b border-slate-700/50 backdrop-blur-md supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-[#1e293b]/90
header_container.description: Sticky container with blur effect for depth. Two main rows: Search/Actions and Filter Scroll.

components.name: FilterPill
components.style_logic: Dynamic class assignment based on 'color' and 'isActive' props using the status_colors palette. Must include smooth transition for background and text color.

universal_guidelines: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out' for all interactive state changes.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px where possible, or use padding to extend hit area.
Dark mode header requires careful border handling: use 'border-slate-700/50' for subtle separation.
Scrollbar hiding: Add '.scrollbar-hide::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }' to global CSS if not present.
Micro-animations: Add scale-95 on click (active:scale-95) for buttons to give tactile feedback.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Create/Update the 'OrderHeader' component (or equivalent) in the appropriate path.
2. Implement the 'status_colors' logic as a helper function or constant map.
3. Use the layout_structure provided: Row 1 (Search+Sort), Row 2 (Horizontal Scroll).
4. Ensure the 'Tümü' (All) filter works as a reset/clear.
5. Mock the 'counts' for now if real data isn't linked, or accept them as props.
6. Add 'data-testid' to: Search Input ('order-search-input'), Sort Button ('order-sort-btn'), and each Filter Pill ('filter-pill-{status}').
